summary: Iteration 6: Drain Tile Overlay. Backend test_iter6_drain_overlay.py: 11 of 12 passed. The fast suite (9 tests) covers Smith S-201 schema, PNG attachment headers, 404 for a sheet with no layout or a bad page/project, the full and foundation-crew PDFs containing 'Drain tile layout — S-201', and the ICF crew PDF not containing it. The slow suite (3 tests, real Gemini) passed: a TEST_Iter4 S-201 draw went generating, then a second POST returned 409, then ready (about 14s) with a valid schema and PNG; the TEST cover returned is_foundation false; the waterproofing crew PDF has exactly one drain layout page, so the non-foundation cover is skipped. iter5 fast regression: 9/9 passed. One unit test failed: render_overlay raises ZeroDivisionError when a polyline has two identical consecutive points. Frontend, desktop on Smith: drain-sheet-select defaults to S-201 (index 2). The SVG has the same box as the sheet image (viewBox 1000x666.7 for a 3000x2000 image), and tile, sump, discharge and cleanouts 0-2 sit on the foundation outline. All 4 layer toggles hide and show their layers; Sump & discharge hides both. drain-download-button downloads drain_tile_S-201.png (142KB). Switching to A-101 shows 'Draw drain tile' with no SVG, toggles or download button. On TEST, drawing A-101 showed 'Drawing…' (disabled), then the overlay appeared about 15s later with no reload. The TEST cover shows drain-not-foundation and no SVG. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow and the overlay stays aligned, but the labels are too small to read. No page errors.

minor.issue: ZeroDivisionError when discharge.points has two identical consecutive points (length 0). This would return a 500 for the PNG, and the whole PDF report fails because render_overlay runs for every ready page. Fix: skip segments where length == 0. The same risk applies to _arrow with identical points (atan2 is OK there, but it draws nothing).
The legend text 'Drain tile — 4" PERF...' renders the em dash as a tofu box, because ImageFont.load_default lacks U+2014. Use '-' or load a TTF such as DejaVuSans.

The legend is always drawn bottom-left. On TEST_Iter4 S-201 the AI put the sump at bottom-left (162,832) with discharge down to y=932, and the legend box fully covers the sump and discharge in the crew PNG and the PDF. Place the legend in the corner farthest from the sump/discharge points, or below the image on extra canvas.

This returns 200 and burns a legend plus the AI's placeholder sump {x:0,y:0,label:'N/A'} at the top-left corner of the cover sheet. Return 404/409 when is_foundation is false, or skip the sump when the arrays are empty.
The 409 guard is a find-then-set, not atomic. Two concurrent POSTs can both start Gemini jobs. Use update_one with filter drain_status != 'generating' and check modified_count.
This always passes mime 'image/png' even when image_path is a .jpg, while run_drain keeps the original extension. It works with Gemini today, but it is inconsistent.

ui_bugs.issue: 'PNG for crew' is shown on a non-foundation sheet (TEST cover, is_foundation false) and downloads a meaningless image. Hide it when ov.is_foundation === false.
No try/catch or toast on failure (a 404 or 500 throws silently). The object URL is never revoked.

issues: SVG labels (CO-1, 1/8"/ft, SUMP / OUTLET, TO DAYLIGHT) use fixed fontSize 14-15 in a 1000-unit viewBox, which comes out at about 5px on a 356px-wide sheet and cannot be read. There is no zoom or full-screen option. Consider a tap-to-expand or pinch-zoom view, or scaling fonts up on small widths.
The discharge line is often very short (about 100 units), so 'SUMP / OUTLET' and 'TO DAYLIGHT' overlap.

On TEST S-201 the top-edge slope arrow points toward CO-1 (the high end) instead of toward the outlet, and the arrows are only 20 units long. Consider checking the arrow direction against the tile path order, or enforcing a minimum arrow length.

action_items: overlay._dashed: skip zero-length segments (length == 0) to avoid ZeroDivisionError, which causes a PNG 500 and makes the whole PDF report fail
overlay legend: replace the em dash with an ASCII dash or load a TTF font that has U+2014
overlay legend: avoid covering the sump/discharge (pick the free corner, or extend the canvas)
drain-overlay.png and UI: don't offer or render the PNG when is_foundation is false; ignore the placeholder sump at (0,0)
start_drain: atomic update for the 409 guard
DrainOverlay: wrap download in try/catch with a toast; make the overlay readable on mobile (expand/zoom or larger labels)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 827 lines (>700). Split the routers.
Report generation calls render_overlay for every ready drain page with no try/except, so one bad AI output breaks every report for the project.
The frontend Overlay hides the whole SVG only when is_foundation === false, so stray placeholder values are hidden in the UI but still burned into the PNG.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12; 1 render robustness unit failure) + iter5 fast 9/9
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; minor and design issues)
